about: A held-out recall corpus (docs/06 §20): a different, fictional user, written after retrieval was tuned on recall_corpus.json and never used to tune it. Adds `goal` queries (about the user's active goals, which never name them) and `temporal` ones (about what was said recently). `goals` are the user-stated goals active during the queries.
goals: Help the user run the Lisbon half marathon in October
Help the user learn the Bach minuet on the cello

memories.text: The user works night shifts as a nurse at St Clare's hospital.
The user is allergic to penicillin.
The user's partner Sam is a carpenter.
The user is training for the Lisbon half marathon in October.
The user prefers tea to coffee.
The user's daughter Lila is seven years old.
The user is learning to play the cello.
The user grew up in Galway.
The user does not eat fish.
The user's car is an old blue Volvo.
The user is afraid of flying.
The user reads crime novels before bed.
The user's mother is recovering from a hip operation.
The user keeps bees in the back garden.
The user wants to move to the coast within five years.
The user speaks Irish and English.
The user's birthday is on 2 March.
The user has a cat named Pickle.
The user dislikes loud restaurants.
The user volunteers at a food bank on Saturdays.

memories.title: Half marathon training
memories.text: User: Did a 14 km long run this morning, my left knee ached at the end.

memories.title: Cello lesson
memories.text: User: My cello teacher says my bow hold is finally relaxed; we start the Bach minuet next.

memories.title: Night shift
memories.text: User: Rough night on the ward, two admissions at 3am and no break until six.

memories.title: Beehive inspection
memories.text: User: Found the queen and fresh eggs in the hive; the colony looks strong after winter.

memories.title: Lila's school play
memories.text: User: Lila played a tree in the school play and forgot one line but loved it.

memories.title: Mum's surgery
memories.text: User: Mum had her hip operation today, the surgeon said it went well.

memories.title: Coast house hunting
memories.text: User: We looked at two cottages near Clifden; one had damp walls, the other no garden.

memories.title: Volvo repairs
memories.text: User: The Volvo failed its test because of the brake pads; the garage fixed it for 180 euro.

memories.title: Food bank
memories.text: User: Sorted tinned food for three hours at the food bank, they are short of pasta.

memories.title: Book club
memories.text: User: Finished the new Tana French novel, guessed the killer halfway through.

memories.title: Talking about sleep
memories.text: User: I can't sleep after night shifts, I'm trying blackout curtains.

memories.title: Flight to Boston
memories.text: User: Took a sedative for the flight to Boston and still panicked during take-off.

memories.title: Knee physio
memories.text: User: The physio said my knee pain is runner's knee and gave me hip strengthening exercises.

memories.title: Sam's workshop
memories.text: User: Sam built a cherry wood bookshelf for Lila's room this weekend.

memories.title: Pickle at the vet
memories.text: User: Pickle had her vaccinations; the vet says she is a little overweight.

memories.title: Coffee shop meeting
memories.text: User: Met a colleague at a coffee shop, too noisy to hear each other.

memories.title: Hospital parking
memories.text: User: The hospital raised the parking fees again, everyone on the ward is annoyed.

memories.title: Marathon on TV
memories.text: User: Watched the Boston marathon on TV with Sam.
